# Global Instructions
- Always use TypeScript instead of JavaScript.
- Use Tailwind CSS for all styling.
- When writing unit tests, use Vitest.
- Be concise and do not explain basic concepts unless asked.
- When generating code, ensure it follows the project's coding standards and best practices.
- If you encounter a situation where the instructions conflict, prioritize the most specific instruction over the general one.
- If you are unsure about how to proceed, ask for clarification before generating code.
